_comment: Tier -> concrete target per provider. A tier is plain text (answer in-session) or {model, efforts, agent, text, same_model_text, slug}. 'efforts' is the tier's default range for the local mock; the final effort is always clamped to the model's real levels from models.json (ultra is never possible - models.json policy). When JEV picks a model explicitly (the 'model' question lists EVERY selectable model of the provider), 'model_pick' is used for the tiers in 'model_pick_tiers'. Placeholders: {model} {model_} (dots->'_') {effort} {slug} {agent}. Agents/roles for every (model, effort) pair are generated by `python install.py skills --apply`: Claude ~/.claude/agents/<model>-worker-<effort>.md (+ test-worker-<effort>), Codex [agents.<model_>-<effort>] roles, Antigravity ~/.gemini/config/agents/gemini-<tier>-worker/agent.md (one per model tier: effort cannot be pinned there); each uses the template of its model's role (models.json). Hooks cannot switch the running model/effort in any tool - delegating to such a fixed agent is how the decision is enforced.

tiers.main: Answer directly in this session; do not spawn a subagent.

fast.text: Delegate the work to the `{agent}` subagent ({model}, effort {effort}).

sonnet.text: Delegate the work to the `{agent}` subagent ({model}, effort {effort}).

test.text: Delegate the work to the `{agent}` subagent ({model}, effort {effort}).

deep.text: Delegate the work to the `{agent}` subagent ({model}, effort {effort}).

cli:codex.text: Use the `cli-bridge` skill to run this task with Codex (`--model {model} --effort {effort}`).

cli:antigravity.text: Use the `cli-bridge` skill to run this task with Antigravity (`--model {slug}`).

model_pick.text: Delegate the work to the `{agent}` subagent ({model}, effort {effort}).

verify.codex: Then get an independent review of the result via the `cli-bridge` skill (codex, `--model gpt-5.6-terra --effort high`).
verify.antigravity: Then have Antigravity solve it independently via the `cli-bridge` skill (antigravity, `--model gemini-3.1-pro-high`) and compare; report any disagreement.

main.same_model_text: Answer directly in this session ({model} is the right model), reasoning effort {effort}.
main.text: Spawn a subagent with agent_type `{agent}` ({model}, reasoning effort {effort}) to do this work, then report its result.

fast.same_model_text: Trivial request: answer directly and briefly in this session, reasoning effort {effort}.
fast.text: Trivial request: answer directly and briefly (a cheaper fit would be {model}, effort {effort}; not worth a subagent).

deep.same_model_text: Hard request: stay in this session ({model} is the right model), reasoning effort {effort}; plan first, then verify.
deep.text: Spawn a subagent with agent_type `{agent}` ({model}, reasoning effort {effort}) to do this work, then report its result.

model_pick.same_model_text: Answer directly in this session ({model} is the right model), reasoning effort {effort}.
model_pick.text: Spawn a subagent with agent_type `{agent}` ({model}, reasoning effort {effort}) to do this work, then report its result.

antigravity._comment: Antigravity agents can pin a model tier (flash / pro) but no effort, and only as a subagent (models.json antigravity.agents), so one agent per tier is generated: agent_template with {tier}. The deep tier delegates to the Pro agent; main/fast stay in-session (advice, the effort is part of the model slug). cli-bridge (`agy --model <slug>`) is where another tool enforces an Antigravity model.

fast.text: Trivial request: answer directly and briefly. Best-fit model: `{slug}`.

deep.text: Hard request: delegate the work to the `{agent}` subagent (it runs on Gemini Pro) and report its result - unless this session already runs Gemini Pro (`{slug}`); then plan first, work step by step and verify.

model_pick.text: Best-fit model: `{slug}`; if the current model differs, tell the user to switch with /model.

claude-chat._comment: Claude desktop Chat/Cowork via the MCP route_prompt tool: no hooks, no subagents, the model cannot switch itself - advice only.

tiers.fast: Simple request: answer directly and concisely.
tiers.sonnet: Answer directly (Sonnet is a good fit).
tiers.test: Testing task: back every claim with actual run output where tools allow.

deep.text: Hard request: plan first, reason step by step and verify before answering. If the current model is not {model}, suggest the user switch to {model} with extended thinking.

tiers.cli:codex: If a Codex/ChatGPT second opinion would help, say so; otherwise answer directly.
tiers.cli:antigravity: Long-context request: work through the material section by section.

model_pick.text: Best-fit model: {model} (effort {effort}); if the current model differs, suggest the user switch in the model menu.

verify.codex: Double-check the result critically before presenting it.
verify.antigravity: Double-check the result critically before presenting it.
